daily_load_assessment: ATL is currently 6.6 with a positive TSB (+6.3), confirming full physiological recovery after a 9-day period without logged training stress. Resting heart rate is stable at 55 bpm. While recovery is optimal for an intense session, missing HRV and sleep metrics require strict self-monitoring during warm-up.
acute_status_assessment_3_weeks: Acute training volume across the last 21 days is critically low, totaling only 71 TSS over 2 running sessions. Consequently, CTL has dropped to 12.9. You are currently in a detrained state relative to your CTL target of 60, requiring immediate reinstatement of consistent training load under a structured 70/30 pyramidal framework.
sport_trend_assessment_6_months: The 180-day trend reveals high volatility—sporadic heavy load days (over 200 TSS) followed by multi-week lulls. This inconsistent pattern prevents sustainable CTL accumulation. To reach CTL 60 safely, ramp rate must stay within +1 to +2 CTL per week via steady Zone 2 volume backed by 2-3 focused quality sessions per week.
coach_verdict: Your high freshness (TSB +6.3) justifies an intense quality session. Focus on Priority 1: a dedicated 5-minute VO2max cycling workout to directly target your cycling power goals. If RPE feels excessively high during the warm-up, immediately downgrade to Priority 2 (Zone 2 Aerobic Run).

priority_1.workout_details: 15 min Zone 2 warm-up with 3x30 sec spin-ups (>100 RPM). Main Set: 5 x 4 min @ 285-300 W with 4 min Zone 1 active recovery @ 125-140 W. 15 min Zone 2 cool-down. Total duration: 60 mins.
priority_1.reason: Top priority to drive 5-minute peak power adaptations and VO2max expansion while TSB is positive and acute fatigue is low.

priority_2.workout_details: 45 min continuous easy Zone 2 run at conversational pace. Finish with 5 x 15-second relaxed strides on a flat surface focusing on quick cadence and posture (45 sec walk recovery between strides). 5 min cool-down walk.
priority_2.reason: Directly builds your 70% pyramidal aerobic foundation toward your 5km running goal without adding structural strain.

priority_3.workout_details: Warm-up: 5 min dynamic mobility. 1) Barbell Back Squat: 4x6 @ 75% 1RM. 2) Barbell Bench Press: 4x8. 3) Heavy Sandbag Clean & Press: 3x6. 4) Kettlebell Goblet Squats: 3x10. 5) Barbell Biceps Curls: 3x10. 6) Core: Weighted Planks 3x45s.
priority_3.reason: Enhances force production for cycling pedal torque and running economy while targeting upper body aesthetic goals.
